candidates.description_excerpt:
High Five is opening a brand-new global R&D center and ASEAN headquarters in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, to develop next-generation banking technology. You will join a fast-growing, AI-first environment focused on cloud-native, composable banking solutions with top engineers from Sweden and Asia.

The role emphasizes ownership, initiative, and collaboration in a distributed team, with English fluency required and Mandarin Chinese or Vietnamese as a plus. Malaysia-based on-site position in KL.
candidates.title: Senior Full-Stack Java Engineer — AI-Driven FinTech Cloud
